name: The Shire
description: The quiet land of hobbits — comfortable, green, and utterly unprepared for the road ahead. Every great journey begins somewhere ordinary.

name: Bree
description: A crossroads town, part of two worlds. Here, Strider appears from the shadows — and nothing is as it seems.

name: Weathertop
description: The ruins of Amon Sûl — a place of ancient watching, and of wounding. The road grows dangerous here.

name: Rivendell
description: The Last Homely House east of the Sea. A place of healing, counsel, and the forging of unlikely fellowships.

name: Moria
description: The vast Dwarven realm, dark and treacherous. The Fellowship must walk through what cannot be walked around.

name: Lothlórien
description: The Golden Wood — a place outside of time, held in the memory of the Elves. Rest here, and see clearly.

name: Rauros
description: The great falls where the Fellowship breaks. Loss is not failure. The mission continues.

name: Fangorn
description: The ancient forest, old as memory. The Ents have been silent too long. There are voices that must finally speak.

name: Edoras
description: The hall of the Horse-lords, half-asleep under a dark counsel. Kings can be restored. Nations can wake.

name: Helm's Deep
description: The fortress where all seems lost at midnight. The dawn comes. It always comes.

name: Isengard
description: The ruined ring of Saruman — industry turned to ruin. What is built against life does not last.

name: Minas Tirith
description: The White City, the last great bastion. The King returns. The siege will not hold forever.

name: Mount Doom
description: Orodruin — the fire where the Ring was forged, and where it must end. This is where the story was always going.

name: The Grey Havens
description: The shore from which some sail West. The ending is not an ending. The sea is not the end.

name: Mount Sinai
description: The mountain of the Law, of encounter, of fire and cloud. God speaks from places that terrify.

name: The Wilderness
description: Forty years of wandering, forty days of Psalms. The desert is not emptiness — it is formation.

name: Valley of the Shadow
description: The dark valley of Psalm 23 — walked, not merely mentioned. The Shepherd goes through it with you.

name: The House of the Lord
description: The destination that was always real. Goodness and mercy follow all the days. You arrive.
